generation_summary.notes: Atomic control of age using tag-based instructions for German language. Instructions will be in English, text in German.

text_constraints: Must be a grammatically correct German sentence.
Text content should not stereotypically suggest a child's perspective (e.g., avoid talking about toys or school).
final text must be written in German
instruction_constraints: Must use the 'Attribute: Value' tag format.
Must include the phrase 'Speak in German.'
final instruction must be in English and should begin with 'Speak in German.'
use fixed tag format 'Attribute: Value' in final realization
